title: Finding the critical path
caption: Path A–B–D takes 9 weeks and path A–C–D takes 11, so the longest path, A–C–D, sets the project at 11 weeks. B is off the critical path, with 2 weeks of float.
alt: Network of four tasks: A (3 weeks) leads to B (4 weeks) and C (6 weeks), which both lead to D (2 weeks). The critical path A, C, D is 11 weeks.
description: Task A takes 3 weeks; B (4 weeks) and C (6 weeks) both follow A.
D (2 weeks) follows both B and C.
A–B–D is 9 weeks; A–C–D is 11 weeks.
The critical path is A–C–D, 11 weeks; B has 2 weeks of float.
